authority: Ryan's session18 instruction to proceed with revised NBA weak-response feasibility and small paired candidate-selection comparison, including necessary scoped monitored inference; new training conditional on findings and a subsequent concrete decision.

data_usage.HOU: Previously repeated checkpoint validation; current fixed feasibility/selector development comparison. No parameter sweep or choice using HOU outcomes in v0.1.
data_usage.DET: Previously inspected excluded post-selection development. Label-assisted feasibility diagnosis only; fixed selector applied without fitting, reference seeds or parameter selection. Not an independent test.
data_usage.SAC: Training-exposed descriptive context and distractor regression, not independent validation.
data_usage.selector_inputs: Only complete model candidate pools, model response/provenance, source dimensions and native timestamps. Reference geometry, visibility, eligibility and outcomes never enter selection.
data_usage.prospective_followups: Any further variant must state its causal reason, parameter change and development selection role before execution. Do not retune v0.1 after viewing DET outcomes. Preserve every run.

extraction.native_score_semantics: Actual component or local-patch sigmoid mass, not probability; never compare mass across thresholds as confidence.

sequence.algorithm: Offline first-order maximum-score sequence with explicit missing state; all original choices revisable; no interpolated coordinates.
sequence.anchor_choices: All original >.3 candidates, not the original selected point. Each weak candidate must be reachable from a strong candidate before and after within the time horizon and speed bound. This is geometric evidence, not proof of ball identity.

decision: First measure actual weak components, localization ceilings, clutter/hidden responses and path ambiguity. Execute the three fixed arms if useful candidate support exists. A positive bounded increment can justify a reasoned refinement without passing the phase. If signal is unavailable or indistinguishable from distractors, use that evidence for a recognition/preprocessing proposal; do not start training automatically.
